name: loopseed
description: Gauntlet-first Seed Kernel with a durable evidence, recovery, integrity, and scheduling shell.

interface.shortDescription: Set a goal and real bar, then loop on the biggest gap until verified or honestly stopped.
interface.longDescription: LoopSeed v0.8 places a small Gauntlet quality kernel at the center of a durable production runtime. The agent chooses the decomposition, inspects the real output, uses an independent critic and blind A/B when useful, attacks the single biggest remaining gap, and ratchets winners. Context recovery, evidence binding, safe fan-out, no-idle scheduling, repair, and fail-closed receipts run as the supporting shell. Gate is the floor; Bar is the ceiling.
defaultPrompt: $loopseed one-shotted <goal>. Choose the strongest inspectable quality bar you can actually compare against, keep the production approach agent-owned, and continue repairing the single biggest real-output gap until the hard floors and bar are verified or an honest stop condition is reached.
$loopseed one-shotted <one natural-language game or product seed>
$loopseed Complete this scoped goal through the smallest real-output loop; use the runtime shell only when it reduces real uncertainty.
